description: This file defines the ChartMapper class in the MigraDoc.Rendering.ChartMapper namespace. The class contains methods to map chart objects from MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel to PdfSharp.Charting representations, facilitating the rendering of charts in PDF documents.

classes.name: ChartMapper
classes.description: A class responsible for mapping chart objects from MigraDoc's DocumentObjectModel to PdfSharp's charting components.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Converts a MigraDoc DOM Chart object into a ChartFrame containing a mapped PdfSharp Chart object.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Static method providing a convenient entry point to map a DOM Chart object to a ChartFrame.
